description: NaMg₂HSe₂O₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 63-79°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.40 Å. There are two inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.17 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.18 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.72 Å) and two longer (1.74 Å) Se-O bond lengths. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.73 Å) and one longer (1.76 Å) Se-O bond length. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Mg, and one Se atom to form distorted ONaMg₂Se tetrahedra that share corners with four ONaMg₂Se tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one OMg₃H tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Mg and one H atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OMg₃H tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Mg and one Se atom.
